title: Satmar Rebbe's Gold Cane
body: Satmar Rebbe Rav Aharon Teitelbaim received a custom gold cane at his great-granddaughter's US wedding, marking a milestone in marrying off a fourth-generation descendant.

title: Rav Moshe Lieber Passes
body: Rav Moshe Mordechai Lieber zt”l, rov of Kehillas Ahavas Shalom in Ramat Beit Shemesh Gimmel, has passed away at 69. He was head of Kollel Or Menashe in Yerushalayim.
